tasks.label: Alpha_to_Alpha
tasks.question: Select the 3 categories with the largest Alpha values. What is the arithmetic mean of the Alpha values over the selected categories?
tasks.prompt:
Select the 3 categories with the largest Alpha values. What is the arithmetic mean of the Alpha values over the selected categories?
All displayed quantities are integer counts in [10,90]. Use the printed category order for ties. Empty sum or count is 0; other aggregates of an empty set are null. A one-element range is 0. Exact integers, finite decimals, and quoted fractions such as "98/3" are accepted. Do not use external tools. Include enough true chart facts to verify the selection and the answer; reporting all relevant facts is allowed. You may add a short "work" string after the evidence and before the answer; it is optional. Output exactly one JSON object whose top-level keys are "evidence", then optionally "work", then "answer". The value of "evidence" is a list; each list entry has exactly the keys "series", "category", and "value".
